select
  chat_id,
  role,
  expires_at,
  is_active
from public.allowed_chats
where chat_id = $1
  and is_active = true
  and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
limit 1;

select
  doc,
  section,
  source_url,
  content,
  created_at
from public.kb_chunks
where kb_ref = 'ceo_x_demo'
order by created_at desc
limit 12;
